releaseNotes:
- New Display card System Tweaks: Force 4x MSAA, show touches, AOD toggle, safe-volume warning off, force resizable, stay-awake-while-charging, status-bar icon_blacklist picker, animations 0.0x. All verified read-back, reversible, with per-card reset + reset-all coverage.
- Animations status now distinguishes 0.0x (Off).
- APK installer: optional Allow downgrade via Shizuku shell pm install -r -d for single APKs (LookBack-style).
